maddeler.e:
نترقرق (form IIq)
# نَتَرَقْرَقُ (nataraqraqu) /na.ta.raq.ra.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَرَقْرَقَ (taraqraqa)
# نَتَرَقْرَقَ (nataraqraqa) /na.ta.raq.ra.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَرَقْرَقَ (taraqraqa)
# نَتَرَقْرَقْ (nataraqraq) /na.ta.raq.raq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَرَقْرَقَ (taraqraqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
